text:
Alex: Quick sync — planning a coordinated version bump across API, runtime, console and SDKs today. Proposed versions: API 1.3.0, runtime 0.9.7, console 2.1.0, python-sdk 1.3.0, js-sdk 2.0.0. Cutoff for merges 4pm PT.

Maria: ack. runtime PR is up but CI flaky on quant tests. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/678 — needs one last infra tweak from @Maria.

Maria: I pushed a fix for the memory allocator; CI rerun in progress. If anyone sees a perf regression on canary after merge ping me.

Kevin: console change is tiny (changelog + version pin). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/211 — needs design signoff for the admin banner text. @Tara can you quick review?

Tara: I can review now, will do in 10. Also double-checking the rollout gating (canary -> 10% -> 100%) with the rollout policy.

Jon: python-sdk and js-sdk PRs are here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/python-sdk/pull/99 and https://github.com/redwood-inference/js-sdk/pull/304. Both include the new header change for api-key fallback. Tests green locally.

Alex: Thanks. Two coordination asks: 1) add a one-line changelog entry in each PR (why bump). 2) update interop test matrix for new runtime minor. Small snippet to run before pushing:
```bash
# from repo root
./scripts/bump-version.sh <component> <new-version>
# run the quick integration checks
./scripts/quick-e2e.sh --component <component>
```

Maria: noted. I'll hold merge until runtime CI stabilizes. ETA ~30m.

pr-bot: New PR merged: runtime #678 (after CI) — checks passed.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment started for runtime 0.9.7 -> canary-1 cluster.

Kevin: Console PR merged (console #211) — changelog added and banner copy approved by Tara.

Tara: Reviewed console, looks good. Approving now. :thumbsup:

Jon: SDKs merged (python #99, js #304). Released new packages to staging registry.

Alex: Great. Final checklist before cutoff 4pm PT:
- confirm changelog line in each repo (API, runtime, console, python-sdk, js-sdk)
- tag release owners in the merge commit message (owner: ...)
- verify interop tests pass (runtime <-> api <-> sdk)
- schedule canary window 30m after merge

Maria: Interop tests are running, currently 12/15 passing — failing on long-seq case that I think is unrelated to the bump. Will post results in 10m.

Alex: If any repo is blocked past cutoff we fallback to rolling the remaining repos separately and keep the others. Call it out in thread.

Maria: Interop green now 15/15. Ready to promote canary after Alex gives final go.

Alex: Go for promote. I'll kick off the coordinated tag and changelog sweep, then merge remaining minor PRs. Thanks all.

deploy-bot: Canary promote: runtime 0.9.7 -> 10% traffic. Monitor: https://telemetry.redwood-inference/streams/runtime

Alex: After promote, please watch latency dashboards for 15 min and post any anomalies here. If none, we proceed full rollout at +30m.

Kevin: Watching console dashboards. No errors so far.

Jon: SDK telemetry looks clean.

Alex: Closing loop — full rollout started. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. :tada:
